vat_zero_rated.legal_product_description: A supply of goods or services where the goods or services are exported from Uganda as part of the supply.
vat_zero_rated.normalized_product_description: zero-rated supply of exported goods or services
vat_zero_rated.legal_reference: Value Added Tax Act, Cap. 349, Section 24(4) and Third Schedule, clause 1(a)

notes: No VAT-RATE-STANDARD record is registered for Uganda: Section 24(3) of the Act states that 'the rate of tax shall be as specified in section 78(2)', and Section 78(2) delegates rate-setting to a statutory order made by the Minister, subject to parliamentary confirmation. The percentage itself is therefore NOT stated in the principal Act text obtained (media.ulii.org / tradebarriers.org mirror, both serving the 31 Dec 2000 base consolidation). The Uganda Revenue Authority's public pages report 18%, but without citing the specific statutory instrument, so it is not treated as a primary-text verification here. This mirrors the Gabon precedent (PR #311): a rate widely reported by secondary/authority sources but not read directly off a dated legal instrument is not registered as verified.
